pay.qrAlt: QR code to pay via UPI
pay.scanHint: Scan this with any UPI app on your phone to pay.
pay.noCallbackNote: We can't see UPI payments, so we'll ask {{name}} to confirm it arrived.
pay.noHandle: {{name}} hasn't added a UPI ID yet.
pay.qrHintMobile: Save this image, then use “scan from gallery” in your UPI app — or scan it from another device.

confirm.title: Confirm a payment
confirm.intro: We can't see UPI transfers, so please check your bank before confirming.
confirm.reference: Reference {{ref}} — look for this in your bank statement

settings.title: Your UPI ID
settings.intro: Add your UPI ID so friends can pay you back from inside PocketCare. Money goes straight to your bank — we never hold it.
settings.guestBlocked: Create an account to add a UPI ID. Guest sessions can't save payment details.
settings.label: UPI ID
settings.replace: Replace with a different UPI ID
settings.invalid: That doesn't look right — a UPI ID looks like name@bank.
settings.privacy: Shared only with people you're in a group with and have a balance with — and only when they go to pay you. Unlike your passphrase-protected data, our server can read this, because it has to hand it to the payer.

payAnyone.title: Pay someone
payAnyone.subtitle: Opens your own UPI app. PocketCare never holds or moves the money.
payAnyone.scanHint: Point the camera at a UPI QR code
payAnyone.claimsName: Code says: {{name}} — your UPI app will show the real account name
payAnyone.footnote: Check the account name in your UPI app before you confirm. PocketCare can't verify who owns a UPI ID.

err.not_upi: That code isn't a UPI payment code.
err.emvco: That's a Bharat QR. Scan it with your UPI app directly — this reader only understands UPI codes.
err.bad_vpa: That doesn't look like a valid UPI ID.
err.unsupported_currency: UPI only supports payments in rupees.
